scripts.api:docker:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.infra.yml -f docker-compose.app.yml up -d --build api
scripts.api:docker:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.infra.yml -f docker-compose.app.yml stop api
scripts.api:docker:logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.infra.yml -f docker-compose.app.yml logs -f api
scripts.api:docker:shell: docker compose -f docker-compose.infra.yml -f docker-compose.app.yml exec api bash
